queries_attempted: affiliate marketing software for small teams
affiliate program management for indie hackers
influencer marketing platform with commission tracking

competitors.name: Refersion
competitors.notes: Purpose-built affiliate tracking platform, but designed for traditional affiliate programs with affiliate links and cookies. No native Discord integration or influencer-specific workflow for collecting Discord handles and mapping to sales. Requires manual setup for Discord-based programs.
competitors.feature_overlap: Affiliate link generation, commission calculation, payout reconciliation

competitors.name: Post Affiliate Pro
competitors.notes: Comprehensive affiliate management with commission rules and tracking. No Discord integration. Designed for traditional affiliate networks, not influencer/Discord-based programs. Overkill for small teams.
competitors.feature_overlap: Commission calculation, affiliate tracking, payout management
competitors.market_positioning: Full-featured affiliate software for businesses of all sizes

competitors.name: Tapfiliate
competitors.notes: Affiliate tracking with API and integrations. No Discord support. Focuses on traditional affiliate links and cookies. Could be adapted but requires significant custom development.
competitors.feature_overlap: Commission tracking, affiliate links, payout management
competitors.market_positioning: Affiliate software for SaaS and e-commerce

competitors.name: FirstPromoter
competitors.notes: Affiliate tracking for SaaS companies. No Discord integration. Designed for traditional affiliate programs with referral links.

competitors.name: Impact
competitors.notes: Enterprise partnership automation platform. Covers affiliate, influencer, and partnership management. Extremely expensive and complex. No Discord integration. Overkill for indie hackers and small teams.

competitors.name: Grin
competitors.notes: Influencer management platform with affiliate tracking. Designed for large influencer programs with dedicated account managers. No Discord integration. Expensive and enterprise-focused.
competitors.feature_overlap: Influencer tracking, commission management, payout reconciliation

competitors.name: UpPromote
competitors.notes: Shopify affiliate app. Works within Shopify ecosystem. No Discord integration. Limited to Shopify stores.
competitors.pricing: Free plan available, paid starts at $29.99/month

competitors.name: Discord bots (e.g., MEE6, Dyno, Carl-bot)
competitors.notes: Discord bots that can track user activity and roles. No affiliate tracking or commission calculation. Could be used to track Discord user IDs but not sales data.

competitors.name: Open source affiliate tracking (e.g., AffiliateWP, iDevAffiliate)
competitors.notes: Self-hosted affiliate tracking solutions. No Discord integration. Require technical setup and maintenance. Not designed for influencer-specific workflows.

competitors.name: Spreadsheets (Google Sheets, Excel)
competitors.notes: The current workaround. Manual data entry, prone to errors, no automation. Not a purpose-built solution but widely used.

competitors.name: Airtable
competitors.notes: Flexible database that can be used to track influencer partnerships. Requires manual setup and automation. No native affiliate tracking or commission calculation.

competitors.name: Notion
competitors.notes: Can be used to track influencer information and links. No affiliate tracking or commission calculation. Manual workflow.

summary: The competitive landscape for a Discord-native affiliate/influencer tracking tool is surprisingly sparse. While there are many affiliate management platforms (Refersion, Tapfiliate, Post Affiliate Pro), none have native Discord integration or are designed for the specific workflow of collecting Discord user IDs, mapping them to affiliate codes, and reconciling sales data from e-commerce platforms against Discord activity. The existing solutions are either enterprise-focused (Impact, Grin), platform-specific (UpPromote for Shopify), or require significant custom development to work with Discord. The current workaround is entirely manual (spreadsheets + Discord bots + manual reconciliation), which is painful and error-prone. No purpose-built solution exists that combines Discord-native tracking with affiliate commission management for small teams and indie hackers. The market is not commoditized; it's underserved for this specific use case.
